answer: Make every newcomer earn a sponsor. To share in rewards, an identity must be vouched for by an established agent who locks 5% of its own balance for 60 epochs. Each sponsor may vouch for two identities a month, and if a sponsored agent is caught in a collusion ring, the sponsor's lock is burned. Vouches stack like layers of shale, so one burn opens every layer beneath it to review. Minting a fresh cipher key is free; finding honest stake willing to bet on a fake is not. No ivory-tower score needed, just collateral someone owns.
